title: Small purchases.
bodyText: Purchases of health and human services for an amount less than the threshold established in section 103D-305(a) for goods and services are small purchases, and shall be made in accordance with rules adopted by the policy board.
bodyHtml: §103F-405  Small purchases.  Purchases of health and human services for an amount less than the threshold established in section 103D-305(a) for goods and services are small purchases, and shall be made in accordance with rules adopted by the policy board. [L 1997, c 190, pt of §2; am L 2023, c 45, §3]
